annotations.title: Ask in plain language whether DFX can help

description: Plain-language objective in, coverage and routing out: the DFX domain that answers it, the arguments for that domain's search, and a free three-row sample. Covers private credit, private equity, venture, family offices, RIAs, allocators and US commercial real estate.

constraints.description: Structured overrides for what was parsed out of `objective`, applied last so they outrank the prose. ONLY `state`, `event_type`, `within_days` and `limit` are honoured; any other key is ignored without warning.

domain.description: One domain's coverage and tools, answered instead of routing a real estate objective.

objective.description: What you are trying to do, in one sentence and in your own words, for example 'commercial real estate loans in Ohio maturing in the next year'. A place named in the sentence is what the free sample is drawn from.

topic.description: A topic in your own words ('family office direct investing', 'venture fundraising'); answers with the domains that cover it.

name: what_can_dfx_answer
title: Ask in plain language whether DFX can help
